title: Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients for Stable Feature Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.23600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely used to interpret neural networks, yet imperceptible input perturbations can drastically alter their attribution maps while leaving model predictions unchanged. We introduce Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients (ERIG), a path-based attribution method that intrinsically attenuates gradient irregularities along the integration path using maximum-entropy softmax weighting with temperature parameter $\tau$. We quantify the effect of the entropy-regularized weighting on attribution stability by using the Lipschitz properties of the model and its gradients. We decompose the attribution change under an input perturbation into a model-response term, whose bound is $\tau$-independent, and a weight-variation term, whose bound decreases at rate $\mathcal{O}(1/(2\tau))$. translated_title: 用于稳定特征归因的熵正则化积分梯度方法
translated_abstract: 基于路径的归因方法（如积分梯度，IG）被广泛用于解释神经网络，然而不可察觉的微小输入扰动可能会显著改变其归因图，而模型预测却保持不变。我们提出了熵正则化积分梯度（ERIG），这是一种基于路径的归因方法，通过使用带温度参数 $\tau$ 的最大熵softmax加权，从内在机制上抑制积分路径上的梯度不规则性。我们利用模型及其梯度的Lipschitz性质来量化熵正则化加权对归因稳定性的影响。我们将输入扰动下的归因变化分解为一个模型响应项（其界与 $\tau$ 无关）和一个权重变化项（其界以 $\mathcal{O}(1/(2\tau))$ 的速率减小）。二者的比值 $R(\tau)$ 刻画了梯度信息与归因稳定性之间的权衡。
tldr: 提出熵正则化积分梯度（ERIG），通过带温度参数的最大熵softmax加权抑制积分路径上的梯度不规则性，并从理论上证明其归因图对微小输入扰动具有更强的稳定性。
en_tdlr: ERIG enhances Integrated Gradients with maximum-entropy softmax weighting controlled by a temperature parameter, providing theoretical bounds showing that attribution stability improves at rate O(1/(2τ)) under imperceptible input perturbations while balancing gradient information and stability.
